documents.t: sdv-py VHL: endpoint references, dataset loaders and parsers for VHL in the SportsDataverse Python package.
VHL — VHL (vhlru.ru server-rendered pages, parsed) — endpoint reference in sdv-py, the SportsDataverse Python package.
Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

sportsdataverse.hockey.vhl — 13 endpoints. Note: Owner flag (sdv-internal-refs/vhl/README.md): the VHL is run by Russian league operators, and several clubs are owned or sponsored by sanctioned state companies. Fetching on your own machine is fine; a published data release or a hosted mirror needs the owner's sanctions / legal sign-off first.

Schedule and results of one season stage: every game with its club ids, score and decision. Endpoint URL: GET https://www.vhlru.ru/en/calendar/{season}/0/ Valid URL: https://www.vhlru.ru/en/calendar/2026/0/?stage=regular

return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the page's parsed record (dict): the sdv-internal-refs capture shape, plus _request (season, stage, tn and the ids asked for).
